text:
maria: Quick sync — starting a Q3+ roadmap thread for routing policies, multi-region tenancy, and multi-tenant isolation. Need to lock launch criteria, scope tradeoffs, and prioritize customer asks. Initial thoughts?
kevin: Can we define explicit SLA tiers per lane? e.g. low-latency lane p99 < 150ms, cost-optimized lane p99 < 500ms. That will help scoping.
sanjay: Agree. We also need a cost-delta estimate for each isolation mode. Back-of-envelope: dedicated slices add ~25-40% infra cost depending on model footprint. Put cost bands in PRD.
lisa: Customer ask to note — large finance prospect requires VPC + single-tenant model hosting + EU residency. This pushes toward Private + Dedicated lanes.
noah: For resilience, propose model-alias + canary + autopromote. If error rate > 1% or hallucination regression on eval set, rollback to fallback model. Sample policy DSL:```
policy {
  route: "latency-lane"
  sLO: "p99 < 150ms"
  fallback: "model-small-alpha"
  canary: { duration: "10m", sample: 0.05 }
}
```
emma: Suggest we surface an "isolation_score" metric per tenant: tail latency variance + error rate + KV cache churn. Helps automate lane assignment.
maria: Action items: Kevin -> draft SLA matrix; Sanjay -> cost bands and TCO deltas; Lisa -> validate customer asks and list top 3 enterprise customers; Noah -> example fallback + canary playbook; Emma -> telemetry definition and threshold recommendations. Meeting Wed 10am to align.
calendarbot: meeting created: "Routing roadmap sync" — Wed 10:00 — Zoom link posted.
kevin: :thumbsup: I'll have the SLA matrix by Tue EOD, might need infra input on capacity multipliers.
sanjay: I'll model three scenarios (minimal isolation, moderate, full isolation) and include estimated infra multiplier + ops burden by Thu.
lisa: Looping in SEs and customer to validate — likely ask will be "dedicated slot + on-prem option" but need confirmation.
maria: If no objections, I'll convert notes to a PRD draft by Fri and tag owners. Ping if you need to adjust deliverables.
noah: Pushed a gist with a fuller policy DSL + canary examples: https://gist.github.com/example (please review).
emma: +1 from infra. Also propose adding an "erosion window" to handle KV-cache warmup when moving tenants between lanes.
maria: Great — thanks all. We'll capture these in the PRD and revisit Wed.
